name: Alabaster Wardens Reports
description: A series of official reports detailing strange crimes happening around the city.

name: Strange Token
description: A small wooden token circled with an exotic metal, featuring three roughly made claw marks.

name: Dark Shard Amulet
description: A heavy, aged bronze amulet featuring a swirling, trapped galaxy of indigo and green.It hums with a faint, cosmic pulse, and a drift of purple smoke sometimes reveals shifting runes.

name: Missing: Verrick
description: A royal decree offering 500 gold for information regarding the King's missing mage cadet.
